_readme: Shared design-token contract for the web UI (web/css/theme.css) and the Android app (ui/theme/Color.kt). There is no generator and no build step: the tests on both sides are the generator (web/tests/design-tokens-contract.test.js, app DesignTokensContractTest.kt), and a value changed on one side only fails CI. To change a token, change it here first, then theme.css and Color.kt. color: every opaque colour custom property of theme.css, keyed by its name without the leading dashes, hex uppercase without alpha. color_alpha: colour tokens with an alpha channel (rgb hex plus alpha 0..1). color_literal: colours both frontends use that are not a custom property (sic-ink = theme.css .sic{color}). fs, sp, r: --fs-N, --sp-N and --r-X in px. size: web-only dimension tokens in px (--hit, --ctl-h, WP MOBILE-1b); the Android contract test does not read this group, Compose sizes its own touch targets. Status words, glyphs, tones and motion live in status-vocabulary.json.
